component.name: Sample Product
component.description: Household inventory and expiry tracking. Two mobile applications and the backend service they require. Identifiers redacted in this published example.

properties.name: cra:scope-note
properties.value: The mobile applications cannot perform their core functions without the backend, so the backend is inside the product boundary and its dependencies are part of this SBOM.

properties.name: cra:external-processors
properties.value: Google Gemini and OpenAI (receipt and voice processing), Telegram (authentication and notifications), Sentry (error reports). Outside the product boundary; documented in section 2.
